# GitHub Copilot

This repository is **Foundry**, a Next.js 15 App Router multi-agent product for SMEs and entrepreneurs.

Follow `AGENTS.md`.

- Put new specialists in `src/lib/agents/specialists/` and register them in `src/lib/agents/registry.ts`.
- Keep the SSE event contract in `src/lib/agents/types.ts`.
- Prefer demo-safe local tools over new npm dependencies.
- Voice: concrete founder counsel, not generic startup jargon.
